analysis:
Examined all supplied source, patches and file metadata. StandaloneServer.swift:1964–1969,1999–2017 replaces GLM disk-hash bracketing with the managed loader's verified digest, checks it through requireGLM5NextLoadedArtifact, and uses that digest for artifact/cache identity. Memory admission, cancellation, retirement and publication guards remain visible. No supported regression is established, but integration must verify GLM5NextManagedLoad and ModelContainerLoading actually hash all loaded bytes against the pinned manifest before exposing verifiedArtifactSHA256; comments alone do not establish this replacement's equivalence (T-012, T-027, T-041).
VerifiedWeightHashStore.swift:58–85 binds reuse to enumerated stat identities; :97–115 persists and reads unauthenticated operator-editable JSON. Permissions 0600 do not protect against ADV-001. This is a new disk-to-registration trust contract, not proof of an authorization bypass: consumers of the store are absent. Integration must verify lookup is restricted to managed-verified models (:123–124), forged aggregate values cannot become authoritative serving/performance/cache identity, and registration claims cannot substitute for current load verification (TB-003, TB-002, T-007, T-027, T-041, T-056). Also check file enumeration matches WeightHasher coverage and record timing at actual callers.
StartupPreloader.swift head patch :108–111,197,221 adds a default diagnostic callback on load/self-test failures without changing the existing retirement policy or cancellation handling. GLM5NextWiredLimitNotice.report is not supplied: integration must check its emitted text preserves bounded public diagnostics and does not expose raw errors/model details or recommend weakening security controls. No prompt, key, authorization, encryption or billing change is directly shown. Remaining uncertainty concerns these changed contracts, not a claim that absent controls are missing.
